accounts.name: 金亨泰

items.text:
"Tides of Annihilation" gives me the same excitement I used to feel playing classic God of War and Devil May Cry.
And then the boss fights take it somewhere completely unexpected. Watching a game push action this far is honestly thrilling—and slightly terrifying as a developer!
#TidesofAnnihilation #gamescom2026
https://t.co/Q24UZRkKsM
items.text_zh:
《湮灭之潮》让我重拾了当年玩经典《战神》和《鬼泣》时的那种兴奋感。
而Boss战更是将它带到了一个完全意想不到的高度。看着一款游戏把动作性推到这种极致，说实话既令人热血沸腾——作为开发者又有点胆战心惊！
#TidesofAnnihilation #gamescom2026
https://t.co/Q24UZRkKsM

items.text:
NO LAW, the new game from Neon Giant—the creators of The Ascent, which I absolutely loved—and KRAFTON, was one of the most impressive trailers at Gamescom for me.  Cheering you on! Can’t wait to see more‼️
#NoLaw #Gamescom2026 #Krafton
https://t.co/2bOsGrrqEv
items.text_zh:
NO LAW，由Neon Giant——《上行战场》的创作者，我超爱那款游戏——与KRAFTON联手打造的新作，是我在科隆游戏展上印象最深刻的预告片之一。为你们加油！迫不及待想看更多‼️
#NoLaw #Gamescom2026 #Krafton
